title: Build in phases
summary: Small phases, honest gates, rollback always available.

blocks.title: Build in phases
blocks.body: A side project in active development. Start whenever, prove each phase, keep the last good version reachable.

items.title: Content schema, one sample, hub
items.detail: The contract first; everything else hangs off it.

items.title: Two mode shells on the same content
items.detail: Present and Read over one tree.

items.title: Document deployment and security boundaries
items.detail: Write down how the product ships and what it intentionally does not do.

items.title: Add extras only when defined
items.detail: Kiosk or display modes wait for a concrete use case.

items.title: Renderer, studio, and presenter controls
items.detail: The current source demonstrates the contract, page patterns, and presentation shell.

items.label: Adding a page never overwrites an older one
Invalid content fails validation with a precise error
Cold direct links, refresh and back keep working
Touch, keyboard, zoom and reduced motion stay usable
A draft never appears in production output
A failed build and a rollback are handled honestly

blocks.title: Non-goals for now
blocks.body: No CMS sync into pages. No accounts or multiplayer editing. No pixel-perfect slide-app clone.

blocks.title: Phasing rule
blocks.body: Each phase should prove one boundary while keeping the last known-good version reachable.

blocks.heading: One useful page, then a second that proves reuse
blocks.body: That is the whole acceptance loop.
